paragraphs: Your email, on your computer, usable from the terminal or your agent.

mxr syncs Gmail, Outlook, Microsoft 365, and IMAP accounts into one local mailbox. It keeps your message history in SQLite, builds a local search index, and exposes the same mail controls through a TUI, a pipeable CLI, a web app, MCP, and an agent skill. Attachment names, types, and sizes are local; mxr downloads attachment contents when you open them, except the PDFs of the receipts, orders and bills it files as records, which it fetches ahead of time within a 512 MB budget (records.pdfprefetch). Send through Gmail, Outlook, or any SMTP server.

Start on Now for people waiting on you and tasks due soon. Open Messages to reply, To do to act on a deadline, Updates to check what changed, Reading for newsletters, or Archive to find a receipt or booking reference. Each mode has its own view and actions; Inbox keeps the arrival-order list.
features: Email bodies, headers, threads, labels, and contacts
Attachment names, MIME types, sizes, plus files cached after you open them
Archive's records and every value read from your mail into them
SQLite as the canonical local store
Tantivy BM25 search across full mailbox history

whatItDoes.text: Your email, on your computer, usable from the terminal or your agent.

requirements.text: They read local context and call the endpoint you configure, a local model server by default or a cloud provider with your own API key, and they never send mail on their own.
